items.title: New Unique Items - the Auspex and Facebreaker
items.summary: In Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients, we are introducing two new Unique Items: the Auspex and a beloved Path of Exile classic, Facebreaker. Unleash a relentless barrage of punches to crush your enemies… and shatter their minds.
